status: NOT APPROVED; proposal only; no collection performed
purpose: Distinguish D106, D111 and the fixed-offset family conditionally; stable arcs do not identify event phase
source_counts: exact constant received logical count per interval; no rounding to nominal target

uncertainty.clock_assumption: Coherent accumulated server clock with endpoint quantization; independent interval truncation and clock-rate error are not bounded by this study

stop_rules: No substitutions or replacement invocations for missing sizes/lives
Keep every failure and unfilled mode/size cell
Stable long boost plateaus may be infeasible because of mass loss; qualify feasibility before requesting a full run
No unconditional physics conclusion without a justified event-to-send timing bound
No mechanics implementation from these results
replication_note: Three arcs per cell are a coverage proposal, not a calculated 80-percent statistical power claim
phase_note: Old/new/adjacent count phases coincide on stable arcs. Single-segment 7ms phase signals are below one u16 angle quantum; this protocol does not resolve hidden tick phasing

actor_control.wanted_heading: last received actor heading plus/minus pi/2 for the named direction
actor_control.boost: held for boost cell, off for cruise cell
actor_control.log: every outgoing command and ping, including unchanged commands

observer_control.stale_action: pause acquisition and retain exclusion; never refresh an earlier pose with later packets

selection: First chronological eligible arc in the assigned cell; end at the first anchor midpoint span meeting the duration. Use actual duration. Retain failed starts and the following one-second stable-count check.
development_cell_assignment: Invocation 1 for even (size index + direction index + mode index); invocation 2 for odd. Indices follow listed order. Heldout invocations 3 and 4 each target one interval in every cell.
